people.name: Hallohesh
people.line: Father of Shallum, a leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Shallum
people.line: Son of Hallohesh, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters, made repairs.
translations.bsb: And next to them, Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half-district of Jerusalem, made repairs, with the help of his daughters.
translations.kjv: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
translations.asv: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
